combo_label: The Village Fete × Herbs & Spices × Stonehenge & Standing Stones

entries.clue: Iced and filled sponge on the home baking stall, sold by the slice or whole
Club of office; a polished stone head from one lay in Bush Barrow
Children hop the length of the field inside a hessian bag and topple over halfway
One plant gives both a warm citrus seed and a fresh leaf that tastes of soap to some
Stubby stone club, its rounded end worked in circles to crush whole seeds
Hard silcrete boulder from West Woods near Marlborough, dressed into the outer ring
Cool green leaf chopped with vinegar into the sauce served with roast lamb
Scratched names and dates, cut into the uprights by centuries of visitors
Solitary leaning block outside the circle, near which the solstice sun comes up
Home-baked bread entered in its own class and judged on crust and crumb
Red deer digging tool, left in the earthwork, that levered out the chalk
